intro.title: Two Sum II (Sorted)
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that solves the Two Sum II problem, where you find two numbers in a sorted array that add up to a specific target. You will learn the core concept of the two-pointer technique, an efficient algorithm for processing sorted data. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, while loops, and conditional logic. This beginner-friendly lesson will guide you step-by-step through implementing the solution, helping you understand how to manipulate pointers to find the correct pair.
intro.usecase: The Two Sum II algorithm is essential for building efficient search and matching features in real applications. You'll use it when implementing autocomplete suggestions that find matching pairs of items, like flight booking systems that search for two connecting flights with specific total durations. It's also crucial for e-commerce price matching tools that find two products whose combined price equals a target budget, or financial dashboards that identify pairs of transactions summing to a specific amount. This pattern enables responsive, real-time filtering in data-intensive interfaces without performance bottlenecks.
